entities.summary: Forde Abbey is a privately owned former Cistercian monastery in Dorset, England. The house and gardens are run as a tourist attraction while the 1,600-acre (650 ha) estate is farmed to provide additional revenue. Forde Abbey is a grade I listed building. Forde Abbey is a abbey in Europe, established in 1101. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
